note: Tahiti content. This file is public until the private-access server in docs/TAHITI.md exists, so keep it to what Nathan is happy to show; stories, photos and videos wait for real access.

npcs.name: Guru
lines: Took you long enough, Nathan. Scooty is parked and ready.
topics: Let's take the scooty for a spin! :: Keys are in the ignition! Watch the tight corners. [action:scooter-ride]
Still coding out here? :: Scooty, laptop, ocean breeze. Best office on the island.
Remember our road trips? :: Endless highways and roadside chai that tasted like victory.

npcs.name: Prince
lines: Oh hey Nathan, you made it! Grab player two controller.
topics: Pass me a controller, let's play! :: Player two is live! Let's take the high score. [action:tahiti-tvgame]
Up for beach volleyball? :: Footwork and fast reflexes! Vanderlinde squad on serve. [action:tahiti-volley-vg]
Crack any security flags lately? :: Pwned a binary exploitation box yesterday. Pure dopamine.

npcs.name: Jeswin
lines: Careful, fresh ink drying on the villa schematics.
topics: Want to take the motorcycle for a run? :: Helmet on, throttle open! Let's cruise the coast. [action:tahiti-moto]
What are you designing right now? :: A timber pavilion that catches the sea breeze naturally.
How's the sand holding up on the beach? :: Moist packed sand makes a solid tiered arch.

npcs.name: Arok
lines: Nathan, lean into the webcam! Chat, say hi to the protagonist!
topics: Let's hop on the arcade machine together! :: Chat is going to love this co-op run! Booting it up now. [action:tahiti-tvgame]
How is the stream chat behaving? :: High energy and demanding an island tour! W's in chat.
What are you editing right now? :: A highlight reel of the gang's funniest beach clips.

npcs.name: Anu
lines: You found the good spot! Told you the view was worth the climb.
topics: You and me, five shots challenge on the hoop! :: Game on! Step onto the ring, release in the green! [action:tahiti-basket]
Remember that hackathon crunch night? :: Coding until sunrise, then cheering when the demo ran.
How does it feel seeing everyone here? :: It feels like all the hard work paid off. Pure joy.

npcs.name: Shabesh
lines: Nathan, hold that frame! The natural rim lighting is cinematic perfection.
topics: Take a picture of me, Shabesh! :: Step onto your mark, face the camera! Three, two, one, flash! [action:tahiti-photo]
If Nathan's journey were a film, what genre? :: A coming-of-age comeback story. Good friends and big dreams.
What lens are you shooting with? :: A 35mm prime. Natural field of view and real atmosphere.

npcs.name: Logesh
lines: The sunset is right on schedule today.
topics: Let's play beach volleyball! :: Euphonium on the court! Let's get a rally going. [action:tahiti-volley-ol]
What electronics are you tinkering with? :: A low power mesh node network across the shoreline.
Hardware never lies, right? :: When code talks directly to physical pins, that is pure craft.

npcs.name: Thianesh
lines: Took the villa stairs? Respect. That counts as your morning cardio.
topics: I challenge you to an eating contest! :: You asked for it! Mash the plate for ten seconds! [action:tahiti-feast]
How is vacation training going? :: Gym first, beach second, food always. No excuses.
What is the secret to recovery? :: Deep sleep, plenty of protein, and showing up every day.

npcs.name: Akshai
lines: Careful, the railing's mine and the TV corner is warmed up.
topics: Pass player two controller, let's play! :: Player two is locked in! Protect the base ship! [action:tahiti-tvgame]
How does the Aratro build test out? :: Passed all stress tests! Hack Odyssey first place was well earned.
What hardware upgrade makes the biggest difference? :: Fast NVMe storage and dual-channel memory.

npcs.name: Pranav
lines: One second, closing a pull request on the balcony.
topics: Up for beach volleyball? :: Time to set and spike! Let's get Euphonium on court. [action:tahiti-volley-ol]
How did the TCE Event Scheduler turn out? :: Runner-up at HackFest 2025! Handled 500 simultaneous registrations.
How do you stay on top of heavy workloads? :: Time blocking, automated tests, and clear milestones.

npcs.name: Sathesh Kumar
lines: Hey, good timing Nathan! Golden hour is hitting the balcony.
topics: Let's do a photoshoot on the balcony! :: Position yourself by the railing. Smile for the Euphonium archive! [action:tahiti-photo]
How do you grade the colors on your photos? :: Warm highlights, deep rich shadows, natural skin tones.
What is your favorite memory with the gang? :: Long balcony dinners where everyone laughs until midnight.

npcs.name: Naveen
lines: Hey, you made it! Balcony tea is steaming.
topics: Up for a beach volleyball match? :: Count me in! Naveen covering the back line. [action:tahiti-volley-ol]
Who is winning on the carrom board? :: My center striker has been deadly! Loser buys snacks.
What is your favorite part of this whole crew? :: How everyone lifts each other up. Nobody walks alone.

npcs.name: Sivasuthan
lines: Took your time, Nathan! Come see the market board. Best return on investment in life is true friendship.
topics: What is your best investment advice? :: Invest deeply in skills, health, and friends who build.
Any philosophy for money? :: The Stoics said to want less, and I try to remember that before I buy anything.
What about calculated risk? :: Seek positive asymmetry: capped downside, uncapped upside.

npcs.name: Shabeer
lines: Come see my savings goal. The progress bars are looking good.
topics: Can we look through the memory album? :: Opening the archive now. Every chapter has a story. [action:open-album]
How do you budget? :: Needs first, then savings, then fun. I write all three down before the month starts.
Tips for saving? :: Move the money the day you get it. What you never see, you never spend.
Fly back to Origin Isle :: Strap in. [action:fly-home]
Not now :: I'll be by the jet.

lines.text: There was traffic. On a private island.
He flew in on a jet and he's still the last one here.
Whoever moved the cupboard, I saw that.
Told you the view was worth the stairs.
Hold still, I'm taking a picture.
After this, food. Also no excuses.

vanderlinde.name: VANDERLINDE GANG
vanderlinde.text: Before the projects, deadlines, and different paths, there was this crew. Old friends, endless conversations, and a room full of memories.

members.name: Nathan
members.text: The guy who turned his life into a game. Somehow, the gang is still part of the main story.

members.name: Harris
members.text: The man behind the controls. If there's somewhere to go, he's probably already planning the flight.

members.name: Guru
members.text: A developer who always has something to build, fix, or figure out.

members.name: Prince
members.text: One of the original crew. Code, conversations, and the usual chaos.

members.name: Jeswin
members.text: The architect of the gang. While everyone else talks about ideas, he's thinking about how to build them.

members.name: Arok
members.text: Another developer in the crew. A familiar face whenever the gang gets together.

outlaws.name: EUPHONIUM
outlaws.text: Different people, one unforgettable chapter. Between classes, projects, deadlines, and random conversations, this crew made college more than just a degree.

members.name: Nathan
members.text: The player who found another crew along the way. Different chapter, same story.

members.name: Anu
members.text: A familiar presence in the college chapter. Usually somewhere close to Nathan when the crew gets together.

members.name: Shabesh
members.text: A familiar face from the project days. Part of the crew that made college interesting.

members.name: Logesh
members.text: One of Euphonium. Always part of the conversations that make the balcony feel alive.

members.name: Thianesh
members.text: The gym connection of the crew. Training, college life, and plenty of conversations.

members.name: Akshai
members.text: Another technical mind in the gang. From projects to random discussions, he's part of the action.

members.name: Pranav
members.text: One of the familiar faces who helped turn the college years into a shared adventure.

members.name: Sathesh Kumar
members.text: Brown-skinned, bearded, and usually seen in a sleeved shirt. Another member of the balcony crew.

places.tahiti: Far from the main island. Away from the noise. Just the people who made the journey worth remembering.

hideout.title: Vanderlinde Gang Hideout
hideout.text: The original headquarters. One room, six friends, and conversations that never really end.

villa.title: EUPHONIUM VILLA
villa.text: Where the college crew gathers. Ocean views, balcony conversations, and no deadlines for once.
